page.overview:
Who is Stunt Men?

The Stunt Man is a minor character encountered in Johnny Cage's Challenge Tower in the 2011 video game Mortal Kombat. Another Stunt Man, Jim, also makes an appearance in Mortal Kombat 11 as one of Johnny Cage's abilities.

The Stunt Man appears to be jealous of the fact that Cage is always in the spotlight. He is so desperate for a lead role that he attempts to defeat Cage on two occasions in the Challenge Tower for tabloid recognition and a chance to star in Cage's movie.

He appears in two challenges: Challenge 13 "'Hey Jerk" and Challenge 14 "Round Two". He also makes a few small cameo appearances during Story Mode firstly among the dead combatants following the Battle of Armageddon, then behind Johnny Cage when he is challenged to fight Cyrax as well as at the coliseum among the combatants waiting to be called to fight.

Jim the Stunt Double from MK11 appears to at least slightly resemble Johnny. Wearing clothes very similar to Johnny's MK4 appearance, but with boxing tape wrapped around his fists, having a a poorly drawn "Johnny" tattoo on his chest seemingly made using a marker, as well as visibly lighter shade of hair, similar to Johnny's hair color as seen in both Deadly Alliance and Armageddon.
